cases.rule: 'initial' is an OpenSysML invention; the pinned StateBodyItem has no such member (SysML.xtext StateBodyItem).
'choice' is an OpenSysML invention; the pinned StateBodyItem has no pseudostates (SysML.xtext StateBodyItem).
'junction' is an OpenSysML invention; the pinned StateBodyItem has no pseudostates (SysML.xtext StateBodyItem).
'region' is an OpenSysML invention; the pinned grammar spells concurrency 'state ... parallel' (SysML.xtext StateDefBody).
'defer' is an OpenSysML invention; the pinned StateBodyItem has no event deferral (SysML.xtext StateBodyItem).
'history' is an OpenSysML invention; the pinned StateBodyItem has no history pseudostate (SysML.xtext StateBodyItem).
TransitionUsage connects with 'first ... then', never 'to' (SysML.xtext TransitionUsage).
PackageBody requires a closing '}' (SysML.xtext PackageBody).
ImportPrefix requires an explicit visibility keyword before 'import' (SysML.xtext ImportPrefix).
AliasMember requires 'for' and a target element (SysML.xtext AliasMember).
OwnedSubclassification requires a superclassifier after ':>' (SysML.xtext OwnedSubclassification).
OwnedFeatureTyping requires a type after ':' (SysML.xtext TypedBy/OwnedFeatureTyping).
DefinitionDeclaration admits no multiplicity; '[..]' belongs to FeatureDeclaration (SysML.xtext DefinitionDeclaration).
EntryActionMember is a StateBodyItem; a part def body admits no 'entry' (SysML.xtext StateBodyItem).
DoActionMember is a StateBodyItem; a part def body admits no 'do' (SysML.xtext StateBodyItem).
ValuePart requires an expression after '=' (SysML.xtext ValuePart/OwnedExpression).
AdditiveExpression requires a right operand after '+' (KerMLExpressions.xtext AdditiveExpression).
AssignmentNode requires a target and value after 'assign' (SysML.xtext AssignmentNode).
ML_COMMENT requires a closing '*/' (SysML.xtext terminal ML_COMMENT).
EntryTransitionMember 'then' requires a transition target (SysML.xtext EntryTransitionMember).
BinaryConnectorPart requires 'to' between the two ends (SysML.xtext BinaryConnectorPart).
'part' is a reserved keyword, not a NAME token (SysML.xtext terminal ID / PartKeyword).
NamespaceExpose requires an imported namespace or filter package after the expose prefix (SysML.xtext:2383 NamespaceExpose).
ViewRenderingMember requires a rendering usage after the render keyword (SysML.xtext:2335 ViewRenderingMember).
RequirementConstraintMember requires a constraint usage after the require keyword (SysML.xtext:2057 RequirementConstraintMember).
FramedConcernMember requires a concern usage after the frame keyword (SysML.xtext:2073 FramedConcernMember).
IncludeUseCaseUsage requires a referenced use case or a use case declaration after include (SysML.xtext:2300 IncludeUseCaseUsage).
ElementFilterMember requires an owned expression between filter and the semicolon (SysML.xtext:229 ElementFilterMember).
Dependency requires a to clause naming its supplier (SysML.xtext:55 Dependency).
TextualRepresentation requires a language string before its comment body (SysML.xtext:103 TextualRepresentation).
AliasMember requires an element reference after for (SysML.xtext:234 AliasMember).
LibraryPackage requires a package declaration after the library keyword (SysML.xtext:188 LibraryPackage).
MultiplicityRange requires a bound expression after .. (SysML.xtext:478 MultiplicityRange).
BindingConnectorAsUsage requires a connector end after = (SysML.xtext:1020 BindingConnectorAsUsage).
SuccessionAsUsage requires a connector end after then (SysML.xtext:1033 SuccessionAsUsage).
FlowUsage requires a flow declaration with both ends (SysML.xtext:1269 FlowUsage, :1289 FlowDeclaration).
Message requires a message declaration with both ends (SysML.xtext:1245 Message).
AllocationUsage requires a to clause naming the allocation target (SysML.xtext:1214 AllocationUsage, :1218 AllocationUsageDeclaration).
IfNode requires an expression parameter after if (SysML.xtext:1596 IfNode).
WhileLoopNode requires an expression parameter after while (SysML.xtext:1615 WhileLoopNode).
ForLoopNode requires an in clause naming the sequence (SysML.xtext:1624 ForLoopNode).
AcceptNode requires a payload parameter after accept (SysML.xtext:1442 AcceptNode, :1446 AcceptNodeDeclaration).
A feature direction prefixes a feature, which must follow it (SysML.xtext:554 FeatureDirection).
Redefines requires a redefined feature reference after the redefines keyword (SysML.xtext:429 Redefines).
References requires a referenced feature after ::> (SysML.xtext:413 References).
Redefinition requires a redefined feature after :>> (KerML.xtext:712 Redefinition).
A multiplicative operator requires a right operand (KerMLExpressions.xtext:267 MultiplicativeOperator).
An exponentiation operator requires a right operand (KerMLExpressions.xtext:276 ExponentiationOperator).
An implies operator requires a right operand (KerMLExpressions.xtext:89 ImpliesOperator).
A null-coalescing operator requires a right operand (KerMLExpressions.xtext:70 NullCoalescingOperator).
A conditional expression requires an else branch (KerMLExpressions.xtext:59 ConditionalOperator).
A classification test requires a type after istype (KerMLExpressions.xtext:185 ClassificationTestOperator).
A cast requires a type after as (KerMLExpressions.xtext:193 CastOperator).
PrefixMetadataAnnotation requires a metadata feature after # (SysML.xtext:129 PrefixMetadataAnnotation).
DecisionNode requires an action body after its declaration (SysML.xtext:1670 DecisionNode).
AssignmentNode requires an expression after := (SysML.xtext:1535 AssignmentNode, :1539 AssignmentNodeDeclaration).
A conjugated port typing requires a qualified name after ~ (SysML.xtext:974 ConjugatedPortTyping).
A real literal requires digits or an exponent after the point (KerMLExpressions.xtext:526 RealValue).
A string literal must be closed (KerMLExpressions.xtext:514 LiteralString).
A range expression requires a right operand after .. (KerMLExpressions.xtext:246 RangeExpression).
A positional argument must follow the comma (KerMLExpressions.xtext:456 PositionalArgumentList).
A feature chain requires a feature after the dot (KerMLExpressions.xtext:448 OwnedFeatureChaining).
A qualified name requires a name after :: (KerMLExpressions.xtext:548 QualifiedName).
An unrestricted name must be closed (KerMLExpressions.xtext:536 Name, UNRESTRICTED_NAME).
A satisfaction subject requires a feature reference after by (SysML.xtext:2135 SatisfactionFeatureValue).
A crossing feature requires a crossed feature after crosses (SysML.xtext:458 OwnedCrossSubsetting).
an alias name comes from the ID terminal, so 'part' cannot spell it
OwnedSpecialization requires a general type after 'specializes' (KerML.xtext SpecializationPart).
'part def' is a SysML production; the KerML grammar has no such keyword (KerML.xtext RootNamespace).
FeatureTyping requires a type after ':' (KerML.xtext TypedBy/OwnedFeatureTyping).
MemberPrefix visibility must be followed by a member element (KerML.xtext NamespaceBodyElement).
a Type body requires a closing '}' (KerML.xtext TypeBody).
A disjoining declaration requires a type after from (KerML.xtext:426 Disjoining).
A conjugation declaration requires a conjugated type after ~ (KerML.xtext:408 Conjugation).
A return member requires a feature after the return keyword (KerML.xtext:943 ReturnFeatureMember).
A feature inverting requires an inverse feature after of (KerML.xtext:634 FeatureInverting).
A type featuring requires a featuring type after featured by (KerML.xtext:652 TypeFeaturing).
A prefix metadata annotation requires a metadata feature after # (KerML.xtext:1069 PrefixMetadataAnnotation).
A multiplicity subset requires a subsetted multiplicity after subsets (KerML.xtext:758 MultiplicitySubset).
A step is a feature and requires an identification or specialization (KerML.xtext:911 Step).
A flow requires both of its ends (KerML.xtext:996 Flow).
Conjugation requires an original type after ~ (KerML.xtext:408 Conjugation).
Redefinition requires a redefined feature after :>> (KerML.xtext:712 Redefinition).
A unioning requires a type after unions (KerML.xtext:444 Unioning).
A connector end requires a referenced feature (KerML.xtext:854 ConnectorEnd).
A metadata feature requires a type after @ (KerML.xtext:1094 MetadataTyping).
a root-namespace import must be private (KerML 8.2.3.5.2 validateImportTopLevelVisibility; pilot Import_RootNamspace_invalid.kerml.xt).
an association end must have exactly one type (KerML 8.2.4.6.2 checkAssociationEndTypes; pilot AssociationTest_EndTypes_invalid.kerml.xt).
a variable feature must be owned by an occurrence type (KerML 8.3.3.3 validateFeatureOwnedVariable; pilot Feature_variable_invalid.kerml.xt).
a nonunique feature cannot subset a unique one (KerML 8.3.3.3 validateSubsettingUniquenessConformance; pilot Feature_nonunique_invalid.kerml.xt).
a feature chain needs at least two chaining features (KerML 8.3.3.3 validateFeatureChainingFeaturesNotOne; pilot FeatureChain_invalid.kerml.xt).
a private member is not visible outside its namespace (KerML 8.2.3.5 name resolution; pilot Import_All.kerml.xt).
a stray '}' after the root member is extraneous input (KerML.xtext RootNamespace; pilot ParsingTests_Import_Visibility.kerml.xt).
A variant must be an owned member of a variation (SysML 7.9 validateVariantMembershipOwningNamespace; pilot Variability_invalid.sysml.xt:55).
An owned usage of a variation must be a variant (SysML 7.9 validateVariationMembership; pilot Variability_invalid.sysml.xt:46).
A variation must not specialize another variation (SysML 7.9 validateVariationSpecialization; pilot Variability_invalid.sysml.xt:50).
A metadata body feature value must be model-level evaluable (SysML 7.24 checkMetadataBodyFeature; pilot MetadataUsage_Invalid.sysml.xt:82).
An element filter condition must have a Boolean result (KerML 8.2.3.2 validateElementFilterMembershipIsBoolean; pilot expressions filter rows).
A state may have at most one entry action (SysML 7.16 validateStateUsageStateDefinitionEntryAction; pilot StateSubactions_invalid.sysml.xt).
Only one subject is allowed (SysML 7.20 validateSubjectMembership; pilot RequirementSubject_Invalid.sysml.xt).
An attribute must be typed by attribute definitions (SysML 7.6 validateAttributeUsageIsReferential; pilot AttributeUsage_invalid.sysml.xt).
An occurrence, item or part must be typed by occurrence definitions (SysML 7.9 validatePartUsage; pilot PartUsage_invalid.sysml.xt).
Only one return parameter is allowed (SysML 7.15 validateReturnParameterMembership; pilot CalculationUsage_Invalid1.sysml.xt).
An enumeration must be typed by one enumeration definition (SysML 7.7 validateEnumerationUsage; pilot EnumerationUsage_invalid.sysml.xt).
A parallel state cannot have successions or transitions (SysML 7.16 validateStateUsageParallel; pilot StateUsage_invalid.sysml.xt).
A connector must have at least two related elements (KerML 8.3.3.1 validateConnectorRelatedElements; pilot Connector_Invalid.sysml.xt).
A filter condition must have a Boolean result (SysML 7.24 checkPackageFilterCondition; pilot MetadataUsage_Invalid.sysml.xt:74).
A filter condition must be model-level evaluable (SysML 7.24 checkPackageFilterCondition; pilot MetadataUsage_Invalid.sysml.xt:68).
A metadata body feature must redefine an owning-type feature (SysML 7.24 checkMetadataFeatureRedefinition; pilot MetadataUsage_Invalid.sysml.xt:93).
A metadata usage must have a concrete type (SysML 7.24 checkMetadataUsageConcreteType; pilot MetadataUsage_Invalid.sysml.xt:104).
At most one individual definition is allowed (SysML 7.9 validateOccurrenceUsageIndividualDefinition; pilot IndividualUsage_Invalid.sysml.xt:36).
Owned usages of a port definition (other than ports) must be referential (SysML 7.13 validatePortDefinitionOwnedUsages; pilot PortUsage_Invalid.sysml.xt:33).
An interface end must be a port (SysML 7.13 validateInterfaceUsageEnds; pilot InterfaceUsage_Invalid.sysml.xt:63).
A package-level feature cannot be redefined (KerML 7.4.7 validateRedefinitionFeaturingTypes; pilot Redefinition_OwningType_Invalid.sysml.xt:28).
A requirement verification must be in the objective of a verification case (SysML 7.21 validateRequirementVerificationMembership; pilot Verification_invalid.sysml.xt:30).
A view may have at most one view rendering (SysML 7.23 validateViewUsageRendering; pilot ViewRendering_invalid.sysml.xt:31).
A redefining feature must have a compatible direction (KerML 7.4.7 validateRedefinitionDirection; pilot PortUsage_Invalid.sysml.xt:57).
Featuring types of redefining feature and redefined feature cannot be the same (KerML 7.4.7 validateRedefinitionFeaturingTypes; pilot Redefinition_OwningType_Invalid.sysml.xt:38).
An individual must be typed by one individual definition (SysML 7.9 validateOccurrenceUsageIndividualDefinition; pilot IndividualUsage_Invalid.sysml.xt:39).
A transition with an accepter must have a state as its source (SysML 7.16 validateTransitionUsageAccepter; pilot TransitionUsage_invalid.sysml.xt:54).

entries.derivation: the unit postfix binds to PrimaryExpression (KerMLExpressions.xtext:308), below AdditiveExpression, so `[mm]` qualifies 110 alone and `+` adds a dimensionless value to a length, which §9.8.9.1 forbids.

V is a VolumeValue and Cp dimensionless, so the first operand has dimension L^6 while T_static has Θ; no reading of the published text shares a dimension, so the defect is documented without a correction.
